question: Can initiation into a higher level still bear fruit when discernment is lacking?
premises: Some receive initiation into a higher level.
They may lack the discernment appropriate to that level.
Even if they fall to a lower end, they can still partake of the fruit of that initiation.
inference: Higher initiation retains efficacy, but without matching discernment its fruit may be received in a lower attainment.
uncertainties: The phrase 'lower end' could refer to a lower postmortem destination or a lower experiential level.
plain_english: Even those initiated into a higher level, if they lack the needed discernment, may end up at a lower level. Still, they share in the fruit of that initiation.
